constraints.statement: Order dependence by itself is too weak; require evidence that the first event changes the operator encountered by the second after fast transients are controlled.
Do not attribute the current frequency-addressed operator family uniquely to cable geometry; a matched modal state-space realization reproduces the gate.
Matched dense recurrence with arbitrary visible-coordinate adaptation is not sufficient under the current untrained gate; compare against same-fast-matrix coordinate-aligned adaptation.
Supplied basis alignment is not evidence that ordinary learning can discover the useful adaptation coordinates. Treat endogenous coordinate discovery as a separate gate.
A purity ratio can improve while absolute target gain vanishes. Track absolute signal/gain alongside selectivity.
Any active-probing advantage should face equal-cost random, balanced/round-robin and fixed-cover policies; adaptivity does not earn privilege from an unbalanced random baseline.
Charge intervention/probe cost explicitly and sweep hidden-cause density before generalizing an active-identification advantage.
If available interventions cannot separate competing hidden mechanisms, return NOT_IDENTIFIABLE instead of forcing one explanation.
Clean hidden-state geometry is not itself a causal program; require counterfactual or intervention fidelity of the extracted abstraction.
WHERE/WHICH/SIGN carrier addressing is an explicit coupling in InformationFlow, not an emergent property of unmodified Navier-Stokes.
Pure world-space re-embedding can leave an intrinsic cable operator unchanged. Separate intrinsic metric/topology from what the structure samples in world space.
When claiming fine structure matters, match coarse graph/spectral summaries and ask whether fine organization predicts downstream response beyond them.
When useful computation moves through coordinates, compare continuing identity tracking against a stale fixed-coordinate identity; initial alignment alone does not establish preservation under drift.
